$comment: High/critical advisories accepted by scripts/check-dependency-audit.mjs. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry; an expired entry fails CI until it is re-reviewed. Remove an entry as soon as a fixed version can be installed.

exceptions.reason: No fixed release exists (advisory covers <=1.4.0, the latest published version). Only the Expo CLI uses it, for expo-updates code-signing certificates; MotionMeet configures no update code signing, and node-forge is not part of the Hermes bundle shipped to devices.
